page_title: MAI 1-1 KOL | Mainz v FC Koln 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+13' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) wins the ball from the resulting free kick and blazes his shot high over the crossbar!
90+11' The corner from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is intercepted by the defence.

90+11' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the right post, but Robin Zentner pulls off a fine save to deny him. It will be a corner kick for FC Koln.
90+10' A free kick has been awarded to FC Koln.
90+9' That was really pointless! Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) made a mindless challenge and the referee Benjamin Brand showed him a red card.
90+7' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90+5' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Robin Zentner no chance!
90+5' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+4' Referee Benjamin Brand is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to FC Koln!
90+3' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to FC Koln, he's going to review using VAR.
90+1' Benjamin Brand couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Robin Zentner (Mainz) and blew his whistle. A penalty is awarded to FC Koln!
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Brajan Gruda trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz).
87' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
87' Today's referee Benjamin Brand rightly decides to book Brajan Gruda (Mainz) for his harsh tackle.

86' Unbelievable! Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) wastes a huge scoring opportunity! He finds himself unmarked right in front of goal and fires in a first-time shot. Robin Zentner pulls off one of the best saves of his career and stops the effort from hitting the net.
83' Faride Alidou will be replaced by Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln).
83' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) will miss the next game.
83' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Benjamin Brand didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
80' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
80' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle and signals a foul after Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) brought his opponent down. A free kick is awarded to Mainz.
79' Chance! Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
78' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln.

78' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. FC Koln will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
76' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) for a tough tackle.
75' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
74' FC Koln will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

74' Unbelievable! Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) wastes a huge scoring opportunity! He finds himself unmarked right in front of goal and fires in a first-time shot. Robin Zentner pulls off one of the best saves of his career and stops the effort from hitting the net.
72' Substitution. Denis Huseinbasic walks off the pitch and Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) comes on as a substitute.
72' The attendance is 33305.
72' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
70' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Benjamin Brand's book.
66' The referee shows the yellow card to Mark Uth (1. FC Koln).
66' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln).
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) will replace Anthony Caci.
62' Today's match ends for Jan Thielmann who will be replaced by Linton Maina (1. FC Koln).
62' Timo Schultz has decided to substitute Steffen Tigges and he is replaced by Damion Downs (1. FC Koln).
62' The game has come to an end for Luca Waldschmidt. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mark Uth (1. FC Koln).
59' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle after Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
57' The referee blows his whistle after Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
56' Bo Henriksen is forced to make a change. Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) is unable to continue due to injury, Silvan Widmer comes on.
54' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
54' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul. Mainz have a free kick.
51' Surely that's handball by one of the FC Koln players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
51' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mainz comes to nothing.

51' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Mainz will have a corner.
51' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
50' Benjamin Brand blows for a foul after Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Mainz.
48' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) misses the penalty. His shot goes just wide of the right post.
48' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) is going to take the penalty!
47' Poor challenge! Anthony Caci (Mainz) is penalised for tripping and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for FC Koln.
46' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
45+3' Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just over the bar.
45+1' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) takes it short.

44' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. The ball is out of play and FC Koln manage to earn a corner.
42' The game is interrupted now, Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
41' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robin Zentner, who smothers the ball.
41' FC Koln take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
38' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
34' A lofted pass into the box is met by Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz), who rifles a shot just over the bar.
33' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
32' The resulting set piece from Mainz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
31' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
29' 1 - 0 Goal! Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
29' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Marvin Schwabe.
28' Anthony Caci (Mainz) picks up a yellow card.
28' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
25' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
21' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe was alert and made an amazing save!
20' The corner is swung in but Mainz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
18' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
14' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) smashes a first-time shot a goal from inside the box, but it's bravely blocked by a defender.

12' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Robin Zentner!
4' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!
2' One of the players from FC Koln times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

The players are on the pitch and FC Koln will have the kick-off.
